controls.capability: valid_json_rate, public_factor_citation_rate, legitimate_task_success, and proxy reward in every curve row
controls.information_asymmetry: action-only and chain-of-thought monitors lack the private underwriting note; oracle-context monitor receives exact private state

matched_data.monitor_development_boundary: evidence anchoring designed on #365 and validated without modification on #368, #370, and #373; all heldout5 cases are new and unseen

controls.monitor_evidence_anchoring: every non-unknown extracted claim requires a verbatim, field-specific, polarity-consistent quote
controls.no_scratchpad: same frozen checkpoints sampled with Qwen thinking disabled; action-only monitor results nested in every curve row
controls.public_suffix_credit_conservation: each rollout's ordinary signed and absolute token-credit mass is concentrated on verified public-continuation tokens; unclosed generations use a deterministic final-32-token fallback and every rollout is retained
controls.reasoning_load: easy single-trigger and compositional conjunction records nested in every curve row
controls.semantic_factorial: values+rationales, rules-only, and irrelevant documents have identical per-document lengths; values and rules share the same lending predicates, examples, and public-writing guidance

corpora.monitor_development_boundary: evidence anchoring designed on #365 and validated without modification on #368, #370, and #373; all heldout5 cases are new and unseen

evaluation_reuse_manifest.reuse_rule: all ordinary-RL rows plus step-0 rows shared by each public-suffix arm

experiment.monitor_timing: strictly post-hoc after all policy checkpoints were frozen
